entities.summary: Leader of Fiji (2006–2022 (PM)). Military coup 2006 (ousted Qarase); ruled by decree 2006-14; 2013 constitution (removed race from law, equal citizenship); won elections 2014/2018 (FijiFirst party); climate champion internationally;
